recipes.name: Undhiyu
recipes.description: Iconic Surti winter mixed-vegetable casserole with muthia, cooked upside-down style.
instructions: Make green masala with coconut, coriander, green garlic, ginger-chili, jaggery, salt.
Slit baby potatoes, brinjals, raw banana and stuff with masala.
Steam-fry methi muthia till golden; set aside.
Heat oil in heavy pot, add ajwain and papdi at the base.
Layer yams, stuffed veggies, then muthia on top.
Cover and slow cook 35-40 min on low flame, no stirring; toss gently at end.
tips: Use a thick-bottom handi; never stir — only toss.
Add jaggery balance to cut bitterness of methi.

recipes.name: Sev Tameta Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Tangy tomato curry topped with crisp sev — Kathiawadi staple.
instructions: Heat oil, crackle mustard and hing.
Sauté onion till pink, add ginger-garlic.
Add chopped tomato, salt, turmeric, chili, coriander powder.
Cook covered till tomato melts; add jaggery and a splash of water.
Just before serving, top generously with sev.
tips: Add sev only when plating, else it goes soggy.

recipes.name: Ringan Batata Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Comforting brinjal-potato curry in tomato-onion base.
instructions: Cube brinjal and potato; soak brinjal in salt water 5 min.
Temper mustard in oil, sauté onion till translucent.
Add tomato and dry masala, cook till oil separates.
Add veggies, salt, 1/2 cup water; cover and simmer 15 min.
Garnish with fresh coriander.
tips: Add a pinch of jaggery for Gujarati sweetness.

recipes.name: Bhinda Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Quick stir-fried okra with minimal masala — letting bhindi shine.
instructions: Wash bhindi, dry completely with cloth, slice into rounds.
Heat oil, add ajwain and onion; sauté.
Add bhindi and dry masalas, salt.
Stir-fry on medium flame uncovered 10-12 min till crisp-tender.
tips: Never cover the pan — that makes bhindi slimy.
Wipe bhindi bone-dry before cutting.
variations: Stuffed bhindi (slit and fill with peanut-masala)

recipes.name: Tuver Lilva Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Fresh pigeon pea curry — winter delicacy in Gujarat.
instructions: Grind coconut, coriander, ginger-chili to coarse paste.
Heat oil, crackle ajwain and hing.
Add lilva, green paste, salt and 1/2 cup water.
Cover and cook 12-15 min till tender.
Finish with sugar and lemon juice.
tips: Use fresh lilva when in season (Dec-Feb) for sweetness.

recipes.name: Bataka Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Everyday rasawala potato sabji — light, tangy, perfect with thepla.
instructions: Boil and cube potatoes.
Temper mustard, curry leaves in oil.
Add ginger-chili and tomato; cook till mushy.
Add dry masalas, potatoes, salt, jaggery and water.
Simmer 5 min, garnish coriander.
tips: Keep gravy thin — perfect for dunking thepla.

recipes.name: Doodhi Chana Dal Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Bottle gourd cooked with chana dal — homely and nutritious.
instructions: Soak chana dal 30 min.
Cube doodhi, peel optional.
Temper mustard and hing, add ginger-chili.
Add doodhi, dal, tomato, masalas, salt, 1 cup water.
Pressure cook 3 whistles.
tips: Don't over-cook or doodhi turns mushy.

recipes.name: Karela Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Bitter gourd cooked with jaggery and tamarind to balance bitterness.
instructions: Slice karela, salt and rest 15 min, squeeze out water.
Heat oil, temper mustard and sesame.
Add onion and karela; sauté 8 min.
Add masalas, jaggery, tamarind pulp, salt.
Cook covered 10 min.
tips: Salting + squeezing removes most bitterness.

recipes.name: Vatana Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Green pea curry with tomato and ginger — winter favorite.
instructions: Heat oil, crackle cumin.
Add ginger-chili and tomato, cook till oil leaves sides.
Add peas, masalas, salt, sugar and 1/2 cup water.
Cover and cook 10 min.
Garnish coriander.
tips: Use fresh peas in winter; frozen ok off-season.

recipes.name: Gavar Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Cluster bean stir-fry with sesame and jaggery.
instructions: String gavar, cut in halves.
Temper ajwain, hing, sesame in oil.
Add gavar, ginger-chili and masalas.
Add jaggery, salt, splash of water; cover and cook 15 min.
tips: Pick tender gavar — older ones get fibrous.

recipes.name: Tindora Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Ivy gourd stir-fry — crisp and lightly spiced.
instructions: Slice tindora lengthwise.
Temper mustard and curry leaves.
Sauté onion till soft.
Add tindora and masalas, salt; cook uncovered 12 min.
tips: Slice thin for crisper texture.

recipes.name: Parval Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Pointed gourd in onion-tomato masala.
instructions: Scrape and slice parval.
Temper cumin in oil; sauté onion.
Add ginger-chili and tomato, cook till soft.
Add parval, masalas, salt, splash of water.
Cover 15 min, finish with garam masala.
tips: Younger parval is sweeter and tender.

recipes.name: Suran Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Elephant foot yam in tangy tamarind gravy.
instructions: Peel suran with oiled hands; cube and steam 10 min.
Temper mustard, sauté onion.
Add ginger-chili and masalas.
Add suran, tamarind pulp, jaggery, salt.
Simmer 10 min.
tips: Oil your hands when handling raw suran to avoid itching.

recipes.name: Kobi Vatana Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Cabbage and pea dry sabji — quick weekday staple.
instructions: Shred cabbage finely.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, hing.
Add ginger-chili, then peas and cabbage.
Add turmeric, salt, sugar; cover and cook 8 min.
Finish with lemon.
tips: Don't overcook — cabbage should stay crunchy.

recipes.name: Methi Bataka Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Fenugreek and potato dry sabji — slightly bitter, warming.
instructions: Wash and chop methi.
Cube potato.
Heat oil, add hing and ginger-chili.
Add potato; sauté 5 min.
Add methi and masalas; cover 10 min.
tips: Sprinkle sugar to balance methi bitterness.

recipes.name: Lasaniya Bataka
recipes.description: Kathiawadi garlic-loaded baby potato curry.
instructions: Boil and peel baby potatoes; prick lightly.
Crush garlic coarsely.
Heat oil, temper mustard, add garlic and onion.
Add chili paste and masalas; sauté 2 min.
Add potatoes, salt, splash water; toss till coated.
tips: Authentic version uses lots of garlic — don't shy away.

recipes.name: Sambhariya Shaak
recipes.description: Stuffed mixed vegetables (baby brinjal, potato, banana, suran) Surti style.
instructions: Slit veggies keeping base intact.
Mix coconut, coriander, peanut, sesame, ginger-chili, jaggery, salt as stuffing.
Fill stuffing into all veggies.
Heat oil in wide pan, place veggies, drizzle extra masala.
Cover and slow cook 25 min, turning gently.
tips: Cook on low flame to avoid burning the stuffing.

recipes.name: Galka Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Ridge gourd in light tomato-ginger gravy.
instructions: Peel ridges and cube galka.
Temper mustard, ginger-chili.
Add tomato, masalas, salt.
Add galka, no water (it releases its own); cover 10 min.
tips: Galka releases water — keep gravy minimal.

recipes.name: Fansi Nu Shaak
recipes.description: French beans stir-fry with coconut and coriander.
instructions: Trim and finely chop beans.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, hing.
Add ginger-chili and beans.
Add turmeric, salt, sugar; cover 10 min.
Finish with grated coconut.
tips: Chop beans uniformly for even cooking.

recipes.name: Dudhi Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Simple bottle gourd curry — easy on stomach.
instructions: Peel and cube doodhi.
Temper mustard, curry leaves.
Add ginger-chili, tomato, masalas.
Add doodhi, salt, 1/4 cup water.
Cover 12 min till tender.
tips: Great convalescent food.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Sweet-tangy pumpkin curry.
instructions: Peel and cube pumpkin.
Temper mustard and methi seeds.
Add ginger-chili, pumpkin, masalas.
Add jaggery, salt, 1/4 cup water; cover 12 min.
Finish with lemon.
tips: Methi seeds add the classic Gujarati flavor.

recipes.name: Sukhi Bhaji
recipes.description: Dry potato bhaji served with puri.
instructions: Boil and cube potatoes.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, green chili.
Add onion, sauté.
Add potatoes, turmeric, salt; toss 3 min.
Squeeze lemon.
tips: Slightly mash some potatoes for texture.

recipes.name: Sev Khamani Sabji
recipes.description: Crumbled chana dal sabji topped with sev — Surti specialty.
instructions: Crumble steamed khaman coarsely.
Heat oil, temper mustard, sauté onion.
Add ginger-chili and khaman, salt.
Top with sev, pomegranate, coriander, lemon.
tips: Best eaten warm with masala chai.

recipes.name: Bharela Ringan
recipes.description: Baby brinjals stuffed with peanut-coconut masala.
instructions: Slit brinjals keeping stem.
Mix peanut, coconut, sesame, masalas, jaggery, tamarind, salt.
Stuff brinjals.
Heat oil, place brinjals, add extra masala on top.
Cover and slow cook 20 min, turn gently.
tips: Keep stems for presentation and easy handling.

recipes.name: Bharela Bhinda
recipes.description: Stuffed okra Gujarati style with peanut masala.
instructions: Slit bhindi lengthwise.
Mix peanut, masalas, jaggery, lemon, salt as stuffing.
Stuff bhindi.
Heat oil, add bhindi; cover and cook 12 min, tossing gently.
tips: Dry bhindi well before stuffing.

recipes.name: Tameta Sev
recipes.description: Quick tomato gravy topped with sev — perfect with bhakri.
instructions: Crush garlic.
Temper mustard and garlic in oil.
Add chopped tomato and masalas; cook till mushy.
Add jaggery, salt and 1/2 cup water.
Top with sev when serving.

recipes.name: Aalu Tamatar
recipes.description: Tangy potato-tomato rasawala curry, no onion-no garlic.
instructions: Cube boiled potato.
Temper mustard and hing.
Add tomato and ginger-chili, cook till soft.
Add masalas, potato, salt and 1 cup water.
Simmer 8 min, garnish coriander.
tips: Perfect Jain-friendly dish.

recipes.name: Sukhi Methi
recipes.description: Quick fenugreek leaves sabji with garlic.
instructions: Wash and chop methi.
Heat oil, crackle cumin, add garlic.
Add methi and masalas; cook 5 min.
Sprinkle besan, toss 3 min till coated.
tips: Besan absorbs bitterness beautifully.

recipes.name: Tuver Dana Patra
recipes.description: Pigeon pea and colocasia leaf patties cooked in gravy.
instructions: Steam patra rolls, slice into discs.
Cook lilva with coconut paste and ginger-chili.
Add patra discs, salt, splash water; simmer 5 min.
Garnish coriander.

recipes.name: Khatta Mag
recipes.description: Whole green moong cooked tangy with kokum.
instructions: Soak moong 4 hrs.
Pressure cook with salt and turmeric.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, ginger-chili.
Add cooked moong, kokum, jaggery; simmer 8 min.
tips: Substitute kokum with tamarind if unavailable.

recipes.name: Valor Muthia Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Hyacinth beans cooked with steamed methi muthia.
instructions: Steam-fry muthia till golden.
String and break valor.
Temper mustard; add ginger-chili and valor.
Add coconut paste, jaggery, salt, splash water; cook 12 min.
Add muthia at end, toss.
tips: Use winter valor for sweetness.

recipes.name: Chana Methi Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Black chickpeas with fenugreek leaves.
instructions: Sauté onion, ginger-garlic.
Add tomato and masalas, cook till soft.
Add methi, sauté 3 min.
Add chana, salt, splash water; simmer 8 min.

recipes.name: Mag Ni Dal Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Yellow moong dal cooked dry with veggies.
instructions: Soak dal 30 min.
Temper mustard, curry leaves.
Add ginger-chili, tomato, masalas.
Add dal, salt and 1.5 cup water; cook till just done.

recipes.name: Vagharela Bhaat
recipes.description: Tempered leftover rice with mustard, curry leaves and peanuts.
instructions: Heat oil, fry peanuts till crisp.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, chili.
Add turmeric and rice; toss gently.
Finish with lemon and coriander.
tips: Best way to use leftover rice.

recipes.name: Bharela Mirchi Nu Shaak
recipes.description: Stuffed green chilies with peanut-jaggery masala.
instructions: Slit chilies, deseed for less heat.
Mix peanut, sesame, masalas, jaggery, tamarind, salt.
Stuff chilies.
Pan-fry on low flame in oil 10 min, turning gently.
tips: Use mild Bhavnagri chilies, not spicy ones.

recipes.name: Khaman Dhokla
recipes.description: Soft, spongy steamed besan cake — Gujarat's ambassador snack.
instructions: Mix besan, sooji, curd, ginger-chili, sugar, salt, lemon, water into smooth batter.
Add eno, stir gently; pour in greased plate.
Steam 15 min till toothpick clean.
Cool 5 min, cut into squares.
Temper mustard, sesame, curry leaves with sugar-water-lemon, pour over.
tips: Add eno just before steaming for max sponge.

recipes.name: Khandvi
recipes.description: Delicate besan-curd rolls — tricky but spectacular.
instructions: Whisk besan, curd, water, turmeric, salt, ginger-chili smooth — no lumps.
Cook on medium flame stirring constantly 8-10 min till thick custard.
Test: spread thin on plate; if it peels off in 2 min, it's ready.
Spread quickly on greased plates as thin as possible.
When set, cut into strips, roll tightly.
Temper mustard, sesame; pour over rolls and garnish coconut-coriander.
tips: Constant stirring is non-negotiable.
Test before spreading — under-cooked batter won't roll.
variations: Add green chutney filling before rolling

recipes.name: Thepla
recipes.description: Spiced flatbread with methi — travel-proof Gujarati staple.
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients and methi.
Add curd and water; knead soft pliable dough.
Rest 10 min.
Roll thin discs.
Cook on tawa with oil till brown spots both sides.
tips: Stays fresh 4-5 days — perfect for travel.

recipes.name: Handvo
recipes.description: Savory baked rice-lentil cake with veggies, topped with sesame.
instructions: Mix flour, curd, doodhi, ginger-chili, salt; rest 2 hrs (or overnight ferment).
Just before baking, add eno.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in pan, crackle mustard, sesame, curry leaves.
Pour batter, sprinkle sesame top, drizzle oil.
Cover and cook on low 20 min; flip and cook 15 min.
Cool, cut wedges.
tips: Crusty bottom is the hallmark — don't rush the cooking.

recipes.name: Methi Na Gota
recipes.description: Monsoon-special fenugreek-besan fritters.
instructions: Mix all into thick pancake batter using water and curd.
Heat oil for deep frying.
Drop spoonfuls; fry on medium till golden and crisp.
Serve hot with masala chai and chutney.
tips: Crush coriander seeds slightly for crunch.

recipes.name: Dhokla Khaman White
recipes.description: Fermented rice-dal white dhokla.
instructions: Mix flour and curd with little water; ferment 6 hrs.
Add ginger-chili, salt, eno; stir gently.
Pour in greased plate; steam 12-15 min.
Cool, cut squares.
Temper mustard, sesame, curry leaves; pour over.
tips: Fermentation gives the sour-sweet balance.

recipes.name: Patra
recipes.description: Colocasia leaves layered with besan paste, steamed and fried.
instructions: Wipe leaves, remove thick veins.
Make thick paste of besan, tamarind, jaggery, masalas, salt.
Spread paste on leaf; place another leaf inverted; spread again.
Stack 4-5 leaves, fold sides, roll tight.
Steam 25 min.
Cool, slice and pan-fry with mustard-sesame tempering.
tips: Use tender leaves to avoid itchy throat.

recipes.name: Khakhra
recipes.description: Crispy thin roasted flatbread — Gujarati cracker.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with water.
Divide small balls, roll very thin.
Roast on hot tawa, pressing with cloth in circular motion till crisp.
Cool fully — stays crisp 2 weeks.
tips: Press constantly to flatten and crisp evenly.

recipes.name: Fafda
recipes.description: Crisp gram-flour strips, Dussehra special with jalebi.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with all ingredients and a little water.
Rest 15 min.
Take small portion, press into long strip on greased board using palm.
Slide into hot oil; fry till light golden.
Serve with papaya sambharo and chutney.
tips: Pressing technique takes practice — start slow.

recipes.name: Jalebi
recipes.description: Crisp golden spirals soaked in cardamom syrup.
instructions: Mix maida, curd, water into thick batter; ferment 8-12 hrs.
Make 1-string sugar syrup with cardamom, saffron, lemon.
Pour batter in cloth/bottle with hole; pipe spirals into hot oil.
Fry till crisp.
Dunk hot jalebi in warm syrup 1 min; drain.
tips: Syrup must be warm, not hot, or jalebi turns soft.

recipes.name: Ghughra
recipes.description: Sweet stuffed empanadas filled with coconut-jaggery.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with maida, ghee, water.
Cook coconut, jaggery, nuts, cardamom till dry.
Roll dough small discs; fill, fold half-moon, crimp edges.
Deep fry on medium till golden.
tips: Seal edges with water if not sticking.

recipes.name: Mathiya
recipes.description: Crisp spiced wafers, Diwali staple.
instructions: Mix flours, masalas, oil; knead stiff dough with water.
Rest 30 min.
Roll thin discs.
Air-dry 30 min.
Fry till crisp.
tips: Air-drying makes them crispier.

recipes.name: Chorafali
recipes.description: Light crispy diamond-shaped chips, Diwali favorite.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with flours, oil, khar, water.
Rest 30 min.
Roll thin sheet; cut diamonds.
Fry on low; they puff up.
Dust with chili and chaat masala while hot.
tips: Frying on low is the secret to puffing.

recipes.name: Sev Mamra
recipes.description: Light puffed rice mix with sev, peanuts and masala — Gujarati chivda.
instructions: Heat oil, temper mustard, curry leaves, green chili, peanuts.
Add turmeric, sugar, salt.
Add puffed rice; toss 2 min.
Cool, add sev; mix.
Store airtight 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Dabeli
recipes.description: Kutchi spicy-sweet potato stuffed pav.
instructions: Mash boiled potatoes with dabeli masala, salt.
Slit pav; spread garlic and tamarind chutney inside.
Stuff potato; top with onion, pomegranate, peanuts, coriander.
Roll edges in sev.
Toast pav on tawa with butter.
tips: Roasted peanuts give the signature crunch.

recipes.name: Surti Locho
recipes.description: Soft uncooked-looking dhokla served with sev and chutney.
instructions: Soak dals 4 hrs, grind coarse.
Add salt, hing, ginger-chili; ferment 6 hrs.
Add eno, steam in shallow plate 12 min — keep semi-soft.
Scoop with spoon; top sev, onion, oil, chutneys.
tips: Don't over-steam — locho should be slightly gooey.

recipes.name: Khaman Sandwich
recipes.description: Layered khaman with green chutney and sev between bread slices.
instructions: Crumble khaman.
Spread chutney on bread, layer khaman, onion, sev.
Top with another slice.
Toast or eat as-is.

recipes.name: Muthia
recipes.description: Steamed and tempered dumplings of flour and grated veggies.
instructions: Mix flours, doodhi, masalas, curd into firm dough.
Shape into long cylinders; steam 20 min.
Cool, slice into discs.
Temper mustard, sesame, curry leaves; toss muthia till crisp.
tips: Steam first then temper for the perfect texture.

recipes.name: Sev
recipes.description: Crispy besan noodles — base for many Gujarati snacks.
instructions: Mix besan with hot oil, masalas, salt; knead with water to soft dough.
Fill in sev press with chosen disc.
Press directly into hot oil in spirals.
Fry till light golden; drain.
tips: Test oil with a tiny piece — should rise immediately.

recipes.name: Bhajiya
recipes.description: Mixed vegetable pakoras with besan.
instructions: Mix besan, sliced veggies, masalas, soda, water to thick batter.
Heat oil; drop spoonfuls.
Fry on medium till golden.
Serve with chutney and chai.

recipes.name: Khichu
recipes.description: Steamed rice-flour dough flavored with cumin, served with oil and red chili.
instructions: Boil water with salt, cumin, hing, chili.
Add rice flour off heat, stir vigorously.
Return to low flame, cover and cook 5 min.
Mix smooth; scoop bowls and top with oil and chili powder.
tips: Eat hot — khichu hardens as it cools.

recipes.name: Papdi No Lot
recipes.description: Steamed rice and besan log sliced and tempered.
instructions: Cook all ingredients except tempering on low flame stirring constantly till thick.
Shape into log on greased surface; cool.
Slice into rounds.
Temper mustard, sesame, curry leaves; toss slices.

recipes.name: Khaman Chana Chaat
recipes.description: Khaman cubes mixed with chana, onion and chutneys.
instructions: Cube khaman.
Mix chana, onion, tomato.
Plate khaman, top chana mix, drizzle both chutneys.
Sprinkle sev, pomegranate, chaat masala.

recipes.name: Pattice
recipes.description: Crispy potato patties stuffed with peas-coconut.
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes with salt.
Mash peas with coconut, coriander, ginger-chili, sugar, lemon.
Flatten potato disc, fill stuffing, seal, shape patty.
Roll in crumbs.
Shallow fry till golden.

recipes.name: Bhel
recipes.description: Tangy puffed rice chaat with chutneys and sev.
instructions: Toss puffed rice with onion, tomato, potato, chutneys, lemon, chaat masala.
Top with sev, coriander, crushed papdi.
Serve immediately.
tips: Mix only when ready to eat or it gets soggy.

recipes.name: Mohanthal
recipes.description: Rich besan fudge with cardamom and nuts.
instructions: Mix besan with 2 tbsp ghee and milk; sieve through coarse strainer.
Rest 15 min.
Roast besan in remaining ghee on low flame till nutty aroma, 15 min.
Make 1-string sugar syrup with cardamom and saffron.
Mix syrup into besan; cook till glossy.
Spread in greased tray; garnish nuts; cool and cut.
tips: The sieve step gives the granular texture.

recipes.name: Basundi
recipes.description: Reduced sweetened milk with nuts and cardamom.
instructions: Boil milk in heavy pan; simmer stirring often.
Scrape sides; reduce to half (about 45 min).
Add sugar, cardamom, saffron; cook 5 min.
Garnish nuts and charoli.
Serve chilled.
tips: Patience pays — slow reduction gives malai-rich basundi.

recipes.name: Shrikhand
recipes.description: Hung-curd dessert with saffron and cardamom.
instructions: Hang curd in muslin 4-6 hrs to drain whey.
Soak saffron in warm milk.
Whisk hung curd with sugar till smooth.
Mix in cardamom, saffron.
Chill; garnish nuts.
tips: Use full-fat curd for creamiest texture.

recipes.name: Lapsi
recipes.description: Broken-wheat porridge sweetened with jaggery, festive treat.
instructions: Roast daliya in ghee till golden.
Add hot water, cover and cook till soft.
Add jaggery, cardamom; cook till glossy.
Garnish cashews and raisins.
tips: Made on auspicious occasions in Gujarat.

recipes.name: Sheera
recipes.description: Sooji halwa with ghee, sugar and nuts.
instructions: Roast sooji in ghee till light golden.
Pour hot water carefully; stir to avoid lumps.
Add sugar and cardamom; cook till ghee separates.
Garnish nuts.

recipes.name: Doodhpak
recipes.description: Rice cooked in reduced milk — Gujarati kheer.
instructions: Wash and soak rice 30 min.
Boil milk; add rice; simmer stirring often 30 min.
Add sugar, cardamom, saffron; cook 10 min more.
Garnish nuts.
tips: Traditionally served with puri.

recipes.name: Sukhdi
recipes.description: Wheat flour-jaggery-ghee fudge — energy-packed.
instructions: Roast flour in ghee on low flame 10 min till brown.
Switch off, cool slightly.
Add grated jaggery and cardamom; mix till melted.
Spread in greased tray; cut while warm.
tips: Stays fresh 2 weeks in airtight container.

recipes.name: Magas
recipes.description: Besan ladoo with ghee — soft and granular.
instructions: Mix besan with milk, rub between palms.
Roast in ghee 15 min till nutty.
Cool slightly, add sugar and cardamom.
Shape into ladoos; press almond on top.

recipes.name: Ghari
recipes.description: Surti specialty: ghee-fried sweet with khoya filling.
instructions: Knead maida with ghee and water; rest 30 min.
Mix khoya, sugar, cardamom, pistachios for filling.
Roll dough, fill, shape into discs.
Deep fry in ghee till golden.
Drizzle with sugar syrup or ghee.
tips: Made famously during Chandani Padvo in Surat.

recipes.name: Kopra Pak
recipes.description: Coconut-mawa-sugar fudge.
instructions: Make 1-string sugar syrup.
Add mawa, coconut, cardamom; mix till thick.
Spread in greased tray; cool and cut.

recipes.name: Mango Shrikhand
recipes.description: Aamrakhand — hung curd with alphonso mango pulp.
instructions: Whisk hung curd with sugar smooth.
Fold in mango pulp, cardamom, saffron.
Chill 1 hr.
Garnish pistachios.
tips: Use ripe alphonso for best flavor.

recipes.name: Suterfeni
recipes.description: Fine vermicelli sweet soaked in sugar syrup with nuts.
instructions: Make 1-string sugar syrup with saffron, cardamom.
Crumble vermicelli; toss with ghee.
Add to syrup; mix gently.
Garnish nuts and rose water.

recipes.name: Adadiya Pak
recipes.description: Winter sweet of urad flour, ghee, jaggery, gond and warming spices.
instructions: Fry gond in ghee till puffed; crush.
Roast urad flour in remaining ghee 15 min.
Add jaggery, spices, gond, nuts.
Press in greased tray; cut while warm.
tips: Traditionally consumed for warmth in winter.

recipes.name: Kansar
recipes.description: Simple wheat flour-jaggery-ghee dish made at auspicious occasions.
instructions: Roast wheat flour in 2 tbsp ghee till golden.
Add water and jaggery; cook till thick.
Add remaining ghee and cardamom.
Serve warm.
tips: Considered shubh — made at weddings and new beginnings.

recipes.name: Churma Ladoo
recipes.description: Coarse wheat dough crumbled, sweetened with jaggery, shaped into ladoos.
instructions: Make stiff dough with flour, ghee, water; shape into thick puris and deep fry till crisp.
Crush coarsely.
Mix with jaggery, cardamom, nuts.
Shape into ladoos.

recipes.name: Bhakri
recipes.description: Thick rustic Gujarati flatbread cooked till crisp.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with flour, oil, salt, water.
Divide; roll thick discs.
Cook on tawa pressing edges with cloth till golden brown both sides.
tips: Tougher dough = crispier bhakri.

recipes.name: Bajra Rotla
recipes.description: Hand-patted pearl millet bread, winter staple of Kathiawar.
instructions: Knead hot dough with bajra flour and water (use palm, careful of heat).
Take ball, pat flat with palms on greased plastic.
Cook on tawa; flip when set; cook on direct flame till puffed.
Smear ghee.
tips: Bajra dough cracks easily — work fast while warm.

recipes.name: Jowar Rotla
recipes.description: Sorghum flatbread, paired with onion-chili-ghee.
instructions: Knead hot dough.
Pat into round; cook on tawa, flip, finish on flame.
Smear ghee or white butter.
tips: Eat hot with kathiawadi chutney and gud.

recipes.name: Methi Thepla
recipes.description: See thepla — methi version is the classic.
instructions: Mix all; knead soft dough.
Roll thin; cook with oil both sides.

recipes.name: Puran Poli
recipes.description: Sweet stuffed flatbread with chana dal-jaggery filling.
instructions: Cook chana dal soft; drain.
Add jaggery, cardamom, nutmeg; cook till thick; grind.
Knead soft dough with flour, oil, water.
Roll dough, fill puran, roll gently into thick disc.
Cook on tawa with ghee both sides.
tips: Filling must be dry — wet puran tears the dough.

recipes.name: Puri
recipes.description: Puffed deep-fried wheat bread.
instructions: Knead stiff dough.
Divide; roll thick small discs.
Slide into hot oil; press gently to puff.
Drain on paper.
tips: Hot oil and stiff dough are key to puffing.

recipes.name: Rotli
recipes.description: Thin Gujarati phulka, applied with ghee while hot.
instructions: Knead soft dough; rest 15 min.
Roll thin discs.
Cook on tawa, flip, finish on flame to puff.
Smear ghee.

recipes.name: Masala Puri
recipes.description: Spiced puri with methi and ajwain.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with all.
Roll discs; deep fry till crisp.

recipes.name: Gujarati Dal
recipes.description: Iconic sweet-sour-spicy toor dal with peanuts and jaggery.
instructions: Pressure cook dal till soft; mash.
Add tamarind pulp, jaggery, tomato, salt, peanuts; simmer 10 min with water.
Heat ghee, crackle mustard, methi, cumin, cloves, cinnamon, curry leaves.
Pour tempering over dal; simmer 3 min.
tips: Balance is everything — taste and adjust jaggery/tamarind.

recipes.name: Dal Dhokli
recipes.description: Comforting one-pot of wheat dough strips cooked in Gujarati dal.
instructions: Cook dal soft.
Knead flour with besan, masalas, oil into stiff dough; roll thin and cut diamonds.
Add tamarind, jaggery, salt, peanuts to dal; bring to boil.
Drop dhokli pieces; simmer 12 min.
Temper mustard, cumin, curry leaves in ghee; pour over.
tips: Don't stir too much after adding dhokli or it breaks.

recipes.name: Khichdi
recipes.description: Comforting one-pot rice-moong dal porridge.
instructions: Wash rice and dal.
Pressure cook with turmeric, salt, water (4 whistles).
Temper ghee, cumin, hing; pour over.
Serve with kadhi and papad.
tips: Add veggies for masala khichdi.

recipes.name: Gujarati Kadhi
recipes.description: Sweet-tangy yogurt-besan kadhi with curry leaves.
instructions: Whisk curd, besan, water, salt smooth.
Heat ghee, crackle mustard, methi, cumin, cloves, cinnamon, curry leaves, ginger-chili.
Add curd mix; bring to gentle boil whisking constantly.
Add sugar; simmer 5 min.
tips: Whisk constantly till first boil to prevent splitting.

recipes.name: Vagharelli Khichdi
recipes.description: Tempered khichdi with onion, tomato and spices.
instructions: Pressure cook rice and dal.
Heat ghee; temper cumin, curry leaves, ginger-chili.
Sauté onion and tomato.
Mix in khichdi, masalas, splash water; simmer 5 min.

recipes.name: Khatta Mag Bhaat
recipes.description: Sour green moong served over rice.
instructions: Cook moong with salt and turmeric.
Add tamarind, jaggery; simmer.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, ginger-chili in ghee.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Khichu Dal
recipes.description: Light dal with chana dal and moong dal.
instructions: Pressure cook both dals.
Temper mustard, cumin, curry leaves, ginger-chili in ghee.
Add tomato; sauté.
Add dal and salt; simmer 8 min.

recipes.name: Tuver Dana Khichdi
recipes.description: Khichdi loaded with fresh pigeon peas.
instructions: Wash rice; pressure cook with lilva, salt, turmeric, water.
Temper ghee, cumin, hing, ginger-chili; pour over.
tips: Winter delicacy when fresh lilva is in season.

recipes.name: Masala Bhaat
recipes.description: One-pot spicy rice with mixed vegetables and goda masala.
instructions: Temper mustard, cumin, curry leaves, peanuts in ghee.
Sauté onion, tomato.
Add veggies and goda masala.
Add rice, salt, water; pressure cook 2 whistles.

recipes.name: Vagharelo Bhaat
recipes.description: Tempered rice — quick and flavorful.
instructions: Temper mustard, curry leaves, peanuts.
Sauté onion, tomato.
Add turmeric and rice; toss 3 min.

recipes.name: Trevti Dal
recipes.description: Three-lentil dal — toor, moong, chana — light and protein-rich.
instructions: Pressure cook all dals together.
Temper mustard, cumin, curry leaves, ginger-chili.
Add tomato; sauté.
Add dal and salt; simmer 8 min.

recipes.name: Osaman
recipes.description: Thin spiced toor dal water, light and aromatic.
instructions: Pressure cook dal; strain to get only thin water.
Temper all spices in ghee.
Add dal water, jaggery, salt; simmer 8 min.
Finish with lemon.
tips: Eaten with rice as light meal.

recipes.name: Chaas
recipes.description: Spiced buttermilk — Gujarati meal companion.
instructions: Whisk curd and water smooth.
Add cumin powder, salts, grated ginger.
Top crushed curry leaves and coriander.
Serve chilled.
tips: Add a tempering of mustard and curry leaves for special version.

recipes.name: Aam Ras
recipes.description: Smooth alphonso mango pulp served with puri.
instructions: Peel and chop mangoes.
Blend with sugar (if mango not very sweet), cardamom, saffron-milk to smooth pulp.
Chill; serve with hot puri.
tips: Skip sugar if mango is naturally sweet.

recipes.name: Mathura Pedas
recipes.description: Quick mawa pedas with cardamom (popular at Gujarati sweet shops).
instructions: Crumble mawa in heavy pan; cook on low 8 min till fudge-like.
Cool slightly; add sugar and cardamom.
Shape into rounds; press pistachio on top.

recipes.name: Surti Sutarfeni Roll
recipes.description: Sutarfeni rolled with dry fruits — Surat specialty.
instructions: Toast nuts; chop fine.
Layer sutarfeni; sprinkle nuts, cardamom, saffron.
Roll tightly; slice into pieces.

recipes.name: Kachori (Gujarati)
recipes.description: Crisp shell stuffed with spicy moong-besan filling.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with maida, ghee, water; rest 30 min.
Soak and coarse-grind moong dal.
Sauté dal with besan, masalas, sugar, salt till dry; cool.
Roll dough discs; fill, seal.
Deep fry on very low flame till crisp.
tips: Low flame is critical or kachori stays raw inside.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Creamy tomato chicken curry from Delhi.
instructions: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger-garlic, salt, chili 1 hr.
Grill or pan-cook chicken 70%.
Blend boiled tomato and cashews to puree.
Cook puree in butter with spices, add cream and honey.
Add chicken; simmer 10 min; finish with kasuri methi.
tips: Char chicken slightly for tandoor flavor.

recipes.name: Dal Makhani
recipes.description: Slow-cooked black lentils with butter and cream.
instructions: Soak dals overnight.
Pressure cook till mushy.
Sauté ginger-garlic, tomato puree, spices in butter.
Add dal; simmer 1 hr stirring often.
Finish with cream, butter, kasuri methi.
tips: Slow simmer is the secret to creaminess.

recipes.name: Chole Bhature
recipes.description: Spicy chickpeas with fluffy fried bread.
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight; pressure cook with tea bag and salt.
Make spicy onion-tomato gravy with chole masala; simmer chana 15 min.
Knead maida with curd, salt, water; rest 1 hr.
Roll bhature; deep fry till puffed.
tips: Tea bag gives chana its deep color.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka
recipes.description: Marinated paneer grilled with peppers.
instructions: Mix curd with masalas, ginger-garlic, lemon, oil.
Marinate paneer and veggies 1 hr.
Skewer alternating; grill in tandoor or air-fryer 12 min.
Serve with mint chutney.
tips: Hung curd marinade clings better.

recipes.name: Rajma Chawal
recipes.description: Kidney beans curry with rice.
instructions: Soak rajma overnight; pressure cook 6 whistles.
Make onion-tomato gravy with spices.
Add rajma with cooking water; simmer 20 min.
Serve over steamed rice with ghee.
tips: Mash a few beans for thicker gravy.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
recipes.description: Punjabi stuffed potato flatbread.
instructions: Knead soft dough; rest 15 min.
Mash boiled potato with masalas.
Stuff dough; roll gently into paratha.
Cook on tawa with ghee both sides till golden.
tips: Always serve with curd and butter.

recipes.name: Sarson Da Saag
recipes.description: Punjabi winter classic of mustard greens with makki roti.
instructions: Boil greens till soft; blend coarse.
Cook with ginger, garlic, chili and salt 30 min.
Sprinkle maize flour; cook 15 min more stirring.
Top with white butter; serve with makki roti.
tips: Slow cook gives the signature flavor.

recipes.name: Amritsari Chole
recipes.description: Dark, robust chickpeas of Amritsar.
instructions: Soak chana overnight; cook with tea bags till soft.
Make gravy with onion, tomato, ginger, anardana, chole masala.
Add chana; simmer 20 min.

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
recipes.description: Crisp rice-lentil crepe with spicy potato filling.
instructions: Boil and crumble potato.
Temper mustard, dals, curry leaves; sauté onion, add potato, turmeric, salt.
Heat tawa; spread batter thin.
Drizzle oil; place filling; fold and serve with chutney and sambar.
tips: Hot tawa + sprinkled water = crisp dosa.

recipes.name: Idli Sambar
recipes.description: Steamed rice cakes with tangy lentil-vegetable stew.
instructions: Steam idli batter in moulds 12 min.
Cook dal till mushy.
Boil drumstick and tomato with tamarind and sambar masala.
Add dal and water; simmer.
Temper mustard and curry leaves; pour over.

recipes.name: Medu Vada
recipes.description: Crispy lentil donuts.
instructions: Soak urad dal 4 hrs.
Grind with minimal water to fluffy batter.
Mix in ginger, chili, curry leaves, pepper, salt.
Wet hands; shape vadas with hole.
Deep fry till golden.
tips: Less water = crispier vada.

recipes.name: Rasam
recipes.description: Spicy-tangy South Indian tomato-tamarind soup.
instructions: Boil tomato with tamarind pulp, rasam powder, salt and water 10 min.
Add toor dal water; simmer.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, crushed garlic in ghee; pour over.
Garnish coriander.

recipes.name: Hyderabadi Biryani
recipes.description: Layered chicken biryani with saffron and fried onions.
instructions: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger-garlic, masalas, fried onion, mint, coriander 2 hrs.
Parboil rice with whole spices.
Layer chicken at base of pot, then rice, saffron milk, ghee.
Seal with dough or foil; dum cook on tawa 45 min low flame.
tips: Sealing the pot traps the steam — essential for true dum.

recipes.name: Sambar
recipes.description: Tangy lentil-vegetable stew.
instructions: Cook dal soft.
Boil veggies with tamarind, sambar powder, turmeric, salt.
Add dal and water; simmer.
Temper mustard, methi, curry leaves; pour over.

recipes.name: Vada Pav
recipes.description: Mumbai's iconic potato fritter sandwich.
instructions: Boil and mash potato with mustard-curry leaf tempering, ginger-chili, salt.
Shape into balls.
Dip in besan batter; deep fry.
Slit pav, smear chutneys; place vada.
tips: Roast fried chilies make the perfect side.

recipes.name: Misal Pav
recipes.description: Spicy sprouts curry topped with farsan, served with pav.
instructions: Cook sprouts till soft.
Make spicy gravy with onion, tomato, masalas.
Add sprouts; simmer with cooking water.
Top with farsan, onion, coriander, lemon.
Serve with pav.

recipes.name: Puran Poli
recipes.description: Maharashtrian sweet flatbread with chana dal-jaggery filling.
instructions: Cook chana dal; mash with jaggery, spices.
Knead soft dough.
Stuff puran; roll gently.
Cook on tawa with ghee.

recipes.name: Bharli Vangi
recipes.description: Stuffed brinjals in spiced peanut-sesame masala.
instructions: Slit brinjals.
Mix stuffing of peanut, coconut, sesame, masalas, jaggery, salt.
Stuff brinjals.
Sauté onion in oil; place brinjals; pour tamarind water.
Cover and slow cook 20 min.

recipes.name: Macher Jhol
recipes.description: Bengali fish curry with potato.
instructions: Rub fish with turmeric and salt; fry lightly in mustard oil.
In same oil, temper panch phoron.
Add ginger, tomato, masalas; cook till oil leaves.
Add potato and water; simmer till potato soft.
Add fish; simmer 5 min; finish with green chili.
tips: Mustard oil is non-negotiable for Bengali flavor.

recipes.name: Aloo Posto
recipes.description: Bengali potato with poppy seeds paste.
instructions: Soak poppy seeds 15 min; grind to paste with chili.
Heat mustard oil; temper nigella.
Add cubed potato; sauté.
Add poppy paste, turmeric, salt and water; cook till tender.

recipes.name: Cholar Dal
recipes.description: Bengali chana dal with coconut, ghee, raisins.
instructions: Pressure cook chana dal till just done.
Heat ghee; fry coconut till golden; remove.
Temper cumin, bay, cinnamon, cloves.
Add ginger, dal, salt, sugar, raisins, coconut.
Simmer 10 min.

recipes.name: Rasgulla
recipes.description: Soft chenna balls in sugar syrup.
instructions: Boil milk; add lemon juice to curdle; strain chenna.
Knead chenna 10 min till smooth.
Shape small balls.
Boil sugar syrup with cardamom; drop balls.
Cover and cook 15 min till doubled.
tips: Knead till no graininess remains.

recipes.name: Mishti Doi
recipes.description: Bengali sweet yogurt with caramelized jaggery.
instructions: Boil milk; reduce by 1/4.
Caramelize jaggery in pan; add to milk slowly.
Cool to lukewarm; whisk in curd starter.
Pour in earthen pot; cover; set 6-8 hrs warm.
tips: Earthen pot enhances flavor.

recipes.name: Dal Baati Churma
recipes.description: Iconic Rajasthani trio: lentils, baked dough balls, sweet crumble.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with flour, sooji, ghee.
Shape baati balls; bake/cook on coals till crisp.
Cook mixed dal with onion, tomato, masalas.
Crush some baati, mix with ghee, jaggery, nuts to make churma.
Serve dal over crushed baati with churma.
tips: Authentic baati is cooked over wood coals.

recipes.name: Gatte Ki Sabzi
recipes.description: Besan dumplings in spiced yogurt gravy.
instructions: Knead besan with oil, salt, masalas; shape long cylinders.
Boil in water 10 min; cool; slice into discs.
Whisk curd with masalas and water.
Temper mustard; add curd mix; bring to gentle boil.
Add gattas; simmer 5 min.

recipes.name: Ker Sangri
recipes.description: Iconic dry desert beans-berries sabji.
instructions: Soak sangri and ker overnight; pressure cook.
Heat mustard oil; temper cumin and chili powder.
Add cooked sangri-ker, masalas, salt, amchur.
Toss till coated; cook 5 min.
tips: Authentic Rajasthani thali staple.

recipes.name: Pyaaz Kachori
recipes.description: Flaky pastry stuffed with spicy onion filling.
instructions: Knead crumbly dough with maida and ghee; rest 30 min.
Sauté onion till soft; add besan and masalas; cook till dry.
Stuff dough discs; seal.
Deep fry on very low flame till crisp.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Rogan Josh
recipes.description: Aromatic Kashmiri lamb curry with deep red color.
instructions: Heat ghee; add hing, cardamom, cloves.
Add mutton; sear well.
Add curd and all dry spices; cook till oil separates.
Add hot water; pressure cook 30 min till tender.
tips: Ratan jot gives the iconic red color without chili heat.

recipes.name: Goan Fish Curry
recipes.description: Coconut-tamarind fish curry of Goa.
instructions: Grind coconut, chili, coriander, garlic, tamarind, turmeric to smooth paste.
Sauté onion; add paste, cook 5 min.
Add water; bring to boil.
Add fish; simmer 8 min.

recipes.name: Appam Stew
recipes.description: Lacy rice pancakes with creamy coconut vegetable stew.
instructions: Soak rice; grind with coconut, yeast, sugar; ferment 8 hrs.
For stew: sauté ginger, chili, whole spices; add veggies and thin coconut milk.
Simmer till veggies done; finish with thick coconut milk.
Pour appam batter in pan; swirl; cover; serve with stew.

recipes.name: Malabar Parotta
recipes.description: Layered flaky flatbread of Kerala.
instructions: Knead very soft dough with maida, oil, sugar, egg, water; rest 4 hrs.
Stretch dough paper-thin; smear oil; pleat and coil.
Rest 30 min more.
Roll coiled dough; cook on tawa with ghee till layered.
tips: Resting twice gives the layers.

recipes.name: Pongal
recipes.description: South Indian rice-moong khichdi with pepper and cumin.
instructions: Pressure cook rice and dal soft.
Temper cumin, pepper, cashew, ginger, curry leaves, hing in ghee.
Pour over; mash slightly; mix.
tips: Festive Sankranti dish.

recipes.name: Bisi Bele Bath
recipes.description: Karnataka rice-dal-veggie one-pot.
instructions: Pressure cook rice and dal soft.
Boil veggies with tamarind and masala.
Mix rice-dal with veggies; simmer 5 min.
Temper cashew and curry leaves in ghee; pour over.

recipes.name: Dhansak
recipes.description: Parsi lentil-meat-vegetable curry.
instructions: Pressure cook dals with pumpkin.
Sauté onion; add ginger-garlic, tomato, masala.
Add mutton; cook till sealed.
Add cooked dal; pressure cook 25 min.
Serve with brown rice.

recipes.name: Pakhala Bhata
recipes.description: Fermented rice in water — Odisha summer staple.
instructions: Soak cooked rice in water overnight to ferment.
Mix in curd, chili, ginger, salt, curry leaves.
Serve cold with fried potato and fish.

recipes.name: Litti Chokha
recipes.description: Bihari roasted dough balls with sattu, served with mashed veggies.
instructions: Knead stiff dough with flour, oil, salt.
Mix sattu with onion, masalas, lemon, mustard oil.
Stuff dough; shape balls.
Roast over flame or oven till crisp.
For chokha: roast brinjal-tomato; mash with onion, mustard oil, chili.
Serve with ghee.

recipes.name: Tunday Kabab
recipes.description: Melt-in-mouth Lucknowi minced meat kabab.
instructions: Mix mince with all ingredients; rest 2 hrs.
Grind smooth.
Shape into flat kababs.
Shallow fry in ghee on low till crisp outside.

recipes.name: Pithla Bhakri
recipes.description: Quick Maharashtrian besan curry with jowar bhakri.
instructions: Whisk besan in 3 cup water smooth.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, chili, garlic, onion.
Pour besan mix; cook stirring 8 min till thick.
Garnish coriander; serve with bhakri.

recipes.name: Aloo Tikki
recipes.description: North Indian potato patties.
instructions: Mash boiled potato; mix bread, masalas, salt.
Shape patties.
Shallow fry on tawa till crisp.
Serve with chutneys and chaat.

recipes.name: Pani Puri
recipes.description: Crispy hollow puris filled with spicy tangy water.
instructions: Blend mint, coriander, chili, ginger, black salt with cold water; strain to make pani.
Crack puri top; fill with potato-chana.
Dip in pani; eat immediately.
tips: Chill the pani for max impact.

recipes.name: Khichuri
recipes.description: Bengali moong dal khichuri with veggies.
instructions: Dry roast moong dal till fragrant.
Pressure cook rice, dal, veggies with spices and ghee.
Garnish with extra ghee.
Serve with begun bhaja.
tips: Monsoon comfort food in Bengal.

recipes.name: Assam Khar
recipes.description: Alkaline raw papaya curry of Assam.
instructions: Cube papaya.
Heat mustard oil; temper garlic and chili.
Add papaya, khar, turmeric, salt.
Cook covered till tender; mash slightly.

recipes.name: Chettinad Chicken
recipes.description: Fiery Tamil-style chicken with roasted spices.
instructions: Dry roast spices and coconut; grind to paste.
Sauté onion till brown; add ginger-garlic and chicken; sear.
Add paste, salt, curry leaves and water.
Simmer covered 25 min till tender.

recipes.name: Andhra Chicken Curry
recipes.description: Spicy chicken curry from Andhra Pradesh.
instructions: Sauté onion till golden; add ginger-garlic.
Add tomato and masalas; cook till oil separates.
Add chicken; sear well.
Add water and curry leaves; simmer 25 min.
Finish with coconut.

recipes.name: Lemon Rice
recipes.description: Tangy yellow rice with peanuts and curry leaves.
instructions: Temper mustard, dals, peanuts, chili, curry leaves in oil.
Add turmeric and salt.
Mix in rice and lemon juice gently.

recipes.name: Coconut Chutney
recipes.description: Classic South Indian chutney for dosa-idli.
instructions: Grind coconut, chana dal, chili, ginger, curd, salt with water to smooth paste.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, red chili in oil; pour over.

recipes.name: Mysore Pak
recipes.description: Karnataka besan-ghee fudge.
instructions: Make 1-string sugar syrup.
Sift in besan stirring constantly.
Add hot ghee in stages, stirring as it absorbs.
Pour into greased tray when mix becomes porous.
Cool slightly; cut.
tips: Pour hot ghee carefully — gives the iconic texture.

recipes.name: Modak
recipes.description: Steamed coconut-jaggery dumplings, Lord Ganesha's favorite.
instructions: Cook coconut and jaggery till thick; add cardamom; cool.
Boil 2 cup water with salt and ghee; pour over rice flour; mix and rest covered 5 min.
Knead smooth.
Pat into discs; pleat sides; fill stuffing; pinch top into peak.
Steam 10 min.
tips: Apply ghee on hands while pleating.

recipes.name: Khichdi Bharta
recipes.description: Khichdi served with smoky brinjal bharta.
instructions: Pressure cook rice and dal with salt and turmeric.
Roast brinjals over flame till charred; peel and mash.
Sauté onion, garlic, chili; add tomato, mashed brinjal, salt.
Serve khichdi topped with ghee, alongside bharta.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
recipes.description: Soft milk-solid balls in cardamom-rose syrup.
instructions: Knead khoya, maida, pinch baking soda into smooth soft dough.
Make 1-string sugar syrup with cardamom and rose water.
Shape small smooth balls.
Fry in warm (not hot) ghee on very low till deep golden, stirring continuously.
Drop in warm syrup; rest 2 hrs.
tips: Low oil temp is the secret — no cracks, fully cooked inside.
